business.what_it_does: ChartMogul turns messy billing data from systems like Stripe and Chargebee into accurate subscription revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn, retention, expansion), and layers AI and native CRM capabilities on top so subscription businesses can analyze revenue, PLG funnels and customer/sales data in one platform.

provenance.quote: Used daily by over 3,000 SaaS companies, including

provenance.quote: Trusted by over 3,000 leading software companies

facts.statement: ChartMogul builds a subscription-aware model from raw billing data (e.g. Stripe, Chargebee) through aggregation, normalization, data cleaning and a subscription/ARR model to produce metrics and filters

provenance.quote: Raw billing data Stripe, Chargebee, etc. / Aggregation & normalization / Data cleaning & preparation / Subscription / ARR model / Metrics & filters

facts.statement: ChartMogul AI lets users ask questions in plain English about live trial, subscription and revenue data and get answers grounded in the underlying customers and numbers

provenance.quote: ChartMogul AI works across your live trial, subscription, and revenue data. Ask a question in plain English and get an answer grounded in the customers behind the trends.

facts.statement: ChartMogul has native CRM capabilities that work alongside subscription and revenue data, letting sales and success teams track opportunities, notes, tasks and customer conversations in one place, without a separate CRM

provenance.quote: We don't have a separate CRM. We use ChartMogul to track who brought in each sale, keep notes and follow-ups for larger accounts, and see how those customers are performing.

facts.statement: ChartMogul tracks revenue across multiple currencies, including customers who switch billing currency mid-lifecycle, distinguishing true expansion from FX-driven changes

provenance.quote: Track revenue across multiple currencies, even when customers switch billing currency mid-lifecycle. See how currency movements affect MRR and other metrics, so you can tell true expansion from FX-driven changes.

facts.statement: ChartMogul's billing-setup handling covers multiple billing systems, auto vs manual collection rules, payment method changes, billing system migrations, delinquent/past-due subscribers, mobile app stores and accounting integrations

provenance.quote: Multiple billing systems / Auto vs. manual collection rules / Payment method changes / Billing system migrations / Delinquent / past-due subscribers / Mobile App Stores / Accounting integrations

entries.verbatim: Before ChartMogul, we could run an income statement in QuickBooks, but we couldn't truly defend our subscription metrics. entries.claim: Companies can benchmark their revenue metrics apples-to-apples against 2,500+ peer SaaS companies, comparing by similar ARR or ARPA

Because thousands of SaaS companies model revenue the same way in ChartMogul, you can finally benchmark apples to apples. See what great actually looks like today across growth and retention, compare yourself to peers with similar ARR or ARPA, and frame your performance for your board and investors.

profiles.name: Baremetrics
profiles.why: Baremetrics explicitly bundles Payment Recovery ("It's time to get it back" on failed/delinquent charges) and Cancellation Insights alongside its metrics dashboard, matching the hypothesis that it is chosen when a founder wants dunning/cancellation recovery bundled in, not just reporting. Our evidence shows ChartMogul's documented strengths on these same pages are accurate revenue-metric normalization and peer benchmarking (E17, E11), not a described dunning or cancellation-recovery workflow, so the two differ on this axis per the material reviewed rather than ChartMogul lacking such a feature outright.
